MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The power strip fits my repeated purchases of power strips and charging cables because extra outlets and USB ports would help me power the electronics I already use.",
    "The battery organizer fits my earlier battery cases and charger; its tester adds a practical way to check loose batteries while keeping them organized."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The NVMe enclosure does not serve the same need as my SD and microSD cards and card reader; I have no current need to house an SSD.",
    "My tripods and lens cap support photography, which does not imply that I want an indoor surveillance camera.",
    "The gaming bundle, headphones and calling headset introduce activities or needs I have not expressed, while the fan splitter and Raspberry Pi case require projects I am not currently doing.",
    "The USB-C adapter is only useful if it connects devices I own; my purchases of other cables do not establish that compatibility."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics accessories seems to have been taken as interest in almost any electronic device or component.",
    "Shared words such as camera, storage or Fire seem to matter too much when the products serve different purposes."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy practical accessories that support devices I already use, so a clear purpose and compatible connection matter to me.",
    "My repeated purchases of memory cards, tripods, cables, battery cases and power strips show specific recurring needs that matter more than a broad interest in electronics."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my need to power and organize existing electronics but stretch that interest into unrelated devices and projects."
}
